preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and (-1 <= x <= 10**5) for x in B)
preconditions.description: Each element in B is either -1 or a non-negative integer ≤ 10^5.
The length of B, N, is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of B matches the given N.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(0 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == N)
postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is N space-separated integers in [0, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(mex([int(A[j]) for j in range(1, i+1)]) == B[i-1] if B[i-1] >= 0 else True for i in range(1, N+1))
postconditions.description: For each i where B[i-1] ≥ 0, the mex of the first i elements of A equals B[i-1]. No constraints for B[i-1] = -1.
